    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The differences are that List Contingency Table uses </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> structure and has </plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> as described.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> B</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ecause it has been found in test that appending a list into another list takes much time, some changes have been made to r</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">educe appending operation</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">s</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. That is, when creating a list, it is initialised at the length it should be, and update all elements in it later, instead of creating an empty list and append a new element every time.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> Here we initialise the contingency table itself at the correct length at the beginning and the update the counts in it later. For a contingency table </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">ct</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(a</plain_text>

      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. Because the result of </plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Full Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> and </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">List Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> both use recursion in their constructor. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Because recursion usually cost more resources than iteration, convert</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ing</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> the algorithm </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">into</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> a loop </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">would</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> make it faster.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">In Algorithm 2 and Algorithm 7, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">traversal through a sparse ADtree could be achieved by a stack and a loop.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Figure 3-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">5 below shows an example of sparse ADtree.</plain_text>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">All MCV subtrees and subtrees with zero count are marked in broken lines which means they are omitted in sparse ADtree. First</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ly, we will discuss how to use</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> iteration instead of recursion to build a </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">List Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> from a non-sparse ADtree.</plain_text>

    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">In the recursion </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">approach</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, MakeContingencyTable makes a contingency table from the Root ADnode. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">T</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">he constructor calls MakeContingencyTable again to make smaller contingency tables for ADnodes </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=1, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=2 and </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=3 respectively. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Eventually</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> it combines them.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">In the iteration </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">approach</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, MakeContingencyTable uses a stack to hold those ADnodes which is to be </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ex</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">pa</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">nd</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ed.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> As shown in Algorithm 9, the stack is initialised with only Root ADnode. There is also a </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">pointer</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> used to </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">indicate</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> which position in the contingency table is supposed to update in next loop. Variable </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">j</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">indicates from which attribute in the attribute list is the contingency table built for. In other words, the </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">current loop is building a contingency table for attribute list {</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">j)</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(j+1)</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, ..., </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(k)</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">}.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">W</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">e use a loop to pop one ADnode at a time and only when the stack is empty, will the loop stop. When an ADnode is popped from the stack, all its children ADnodes will be pushed into the stack in reverse order. ADnode will be expanded in such a way only if it has one or more Vary nodes children. When ADnode does not have any children, it means the ADnode is leaf node which stores count. And the count is got and assigned to the corresponding position in contingency table.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Note that, when the ADnode popped represents a subtree with zero count, it is not necessary to update contingency table with 0 because the contingency table is initialised with all counts 0. It is only necessary to move the pointer forward several numbers to skip those zero counts. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">In general, any ADnode with zero count will be represented as NULL and pushed into the stack. Consider the contingency table is built for attribute list {</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">i(</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The pointer is pointing the fifth count in contingency table. Because subtree of ADnode </plain_text>

In other words, the last two counts in contingency table are not updated since they are already initialised as 0.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The recursion approach actually also uses a stack by the constructor of calling itself. However, it could be faster by using a stack discussed above because only the ADnodes is pushed into the stack. Since the ADnodes are the only necessary information for building contingency tables, it could cost more unnecessary memory and time for saving variables by system in Algorithm 2. In other words, when the constructor calling itself in Algorithm 2, all variables, such as attribute list, MCV and the contingency table which is not yet been built completely, are all saved by the system. However, we can achieve the same function by pushing only ADnodes instead, by which much memory and time have been saved.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="Heading3" styleName="heading 3">

      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ing</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> contingency table from</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> a</plain_text>
      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">s</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> of elements stored in stack: MCV numbers and MCV flag.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> And we have to consider what ADnode to push when it is a MCV node. Problems </plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> when and how to make subtraction of contingency tables to make the MCV part are also raised.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ctai(2), ai(3), …, ai(k)ai(1)=v</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> where </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> range from 1 to </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">n</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> and does not </plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> MCV. And the contingency table </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ctai(2), ai(3), …, ai(k)ai(1)=MCV</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is built by subtraction of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">ct</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(2)</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">) with those contingency tables that are not MCV. In other words, the parent ADnode pushed in to the stack is just used for building </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> this algorithm more clearly, an example is described below. Only the first six steps are shown in </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">7. Each step represents one or two cycles in the loop. The following is the explanation of this process.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="ListParagraph" styleName="List Paragraph">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The stack is initialised with only one Root ADnode.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> The</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">c</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ontingency table is empty. The pointer points at the first number of contingency table.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">To build contingency table of attributes {a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">}, Root ADnode is popped from the stack and ex</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">pa</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">nded. First, the MCV of the Vary node child </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> of Root ADnode is pushed into stack. Then a MCV flag is pushed. This flag could be a string or a character. In this implementation it is simply numb</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">er -1. The MCV flag is used for indicating that all the children subtrees of Root ADnode have been converted to</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> contingency table only except the MCV part. So when the MCV flag is popped, the process of making MCV part will start. In this step, after MCV flag is pushed, all the children ADnodes of Vary node </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> are pushed</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> in reverse order</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> except the MCV ADnode. The current ADnode which is just popped in this step is pushed again to the stack instead of MCV ADnode. As shown in this example, Root ADnode is pushed instead of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=2 ADnode.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="ListParagraph" styleName="List Paragraph">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=1 is popped. In other words, now it is going to build contingency table of attributes {a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">} from ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=1 first. This ADnode also has child node. As a result, it is expanded</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> starting from pushing the MCV of its Vary node child </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">A</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">fter MCV flag is pushed, the two children ADnode of this Vary node are pushed in reverse order expect the first child which is MCV. So the current ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=1 is pushed to the stack instead.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="ListParagraph" styleName="List Paragraph">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=1 is popped. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Now we need to get the count from ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=1. When to get the count and when to expand one ADnode will be discussed later. The count is 2 so that the position the pointer is pointing </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">to</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> in the contingency table is updated.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> Then</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> the</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> pointer moves forward to the second position.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">After this, ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=2 is popped, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">and the count 1 in this ADnode is assigned to the second number in contingency table. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Eventually</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> pointer move forward by 1.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="ListParagraph" styleName="List Paragraph">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The MCV flag is popped which means it is time to make the MCV part in contingency table. The first number in contingency table </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">represents</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ct*a1=1</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. The second number in contingency table </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">represents </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ct*a1=1, a2=2</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">From the property of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">contingency table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> discussed in </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">formula (2.3)</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, it can be deduced that </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ct*a1=1, a2=1</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> = </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ct*a1=1, a2=*</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> - </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ct*a1=1, a2=2</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. So the first count 2 is subtracted with the second count 1, and result is 1 as shown in </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Figure 3-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">7.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> Until now, contingency table </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">cta2a1=1</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is already built which is represented by the first two counts. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">In this step it is only necessary to subtract </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">two counts. Generally, this operation means subtraction of two conditional contingency tables </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">is</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> made. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">It has the same function with SubInRow in Algorithm 2.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="ListParagraph" styleName="List Paragraph">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Root ADnode is popped. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Root ADnode is expanded by pushing MCV and MCV flag. And children nodes of Vary node </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> whose parent is Root ADnode are pushed into stack except MCV. The MCV part is also replaced by the current node Root ADnode.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="ListParagraph" styleName="List Paragraph">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=1 and Root ADnode are popped which makes the third and forth counts in contingency table updated as 2 and 6.</plain_text>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">}, but only for {</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">}. In other words, it is used to build </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">cta2a1=*</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> so that after the </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">cta2a1=3</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is computed, we can make subtraction of </plain_text>
      </text_run>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> - </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">cta2a1=1</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> - </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">cta2a1=3</formula>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> Eventually, contingency </plain_text>
