      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ct(a1, a2)</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Because contingency table is built by iteration, the constructor calling itself is avoided. This saves much resources cost, both on memory and time.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> S</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ince all counts are saved in one list, rather than several contingency tables separately, there is no need to concatenate contingency tables any more. All counts are all initialised in the same list and updated. By omitting process of concatenating, it is even faster.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="Heading3" styleName="heading 3">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">Condition of Expanding ADnodes in the Stack</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The question is raised in step 3 </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">of</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> when should ADnodes be expanded and when should they be used to get</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> count. First, there are two type of ADnode. One type is those ADnodes which have </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Vary nodes children</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. We call this type of ADnodes intermediate nodes. Another type is those ADnodes which do not have any </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Vary nodes children</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. We call those ADnodes leaves. It can be learn</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ed</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> from the </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Figure 3-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">5 that</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> actually in a non-sparse ADtree, all information necessary to build a contingency table are stored in leaves.</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">}.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> In the ADtree, an ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">j)</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is a leaf node if and only if </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">j</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> And when ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is popped from the stack, the variable </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is actually greater than that </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">j</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(j)</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> by 1. Therefore, in </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=1. Because that MCV ADnode is a leaf node, the ADnode </plain_text>
      </text_run>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="Heading3" styleName="heading 3">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">Subtraction of Iterated List Contingency Tables</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">There is another problem raised after using iteration to build contingency table. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The SubInRow process could be simply done by make subtraction between two contingency tables when using recursion approach because the counts are stored in two contingency tables separately. However, in </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Iterated List Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> all the counts are stored in one list. As a result, it must be indicated clearly which fragments of the list are </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">those used to make subtraction.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Consider a circumstance shown in </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Figure 3-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">8. It shows a contingency table that built for attribute list {</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">}</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> from the sparse ADtree in </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">In fact Algorithm 11 achieves the same function of SubInRow in Algorithm 2. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The example explained above is the subtraction </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">process from step 6 to step 7 in </plain_text>
      </text_run>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">9. This figure shows the whole process of subtraction in the contingency table. Subtraction of contingency tables not only happens between 6 and 7, but also happens from step 2 to step 3 and from step 4 to step 5.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="Heading3" styleName="heading 3">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">Built from Leaf-List</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> array to store all the counts and represents the query by the index of a count. However there might be many zero counts in the contingency table. Consider a dataset with 1 million records where each record has 10 attributes with arity value of 10. There will be 10 billion possible queries which </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Figure 3-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">10</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">: Converting from List Contingency Table to Dict Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Dict Contingency Table uses</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> map structure to save the information. Since map stores information in a format of key and value pair: (key, value) and all the keys must be distinct. The key could be put the row number of a count in the </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">List Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> and the value is the count. Because the row number could represent the query by using </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Product List</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, it is still possible to write and read a count by query from the contingency table. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">And it does not save those number</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">s</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> with zero counts</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. As a result, the memory cost of contingency table will be only 0.01% of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">List Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> by using map in the example discussed above.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Consider a dataset with </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">R</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> records, and </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">M</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> attributes. To make it simple, we suppose that all attributes have the same arity of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">n</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">T</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">he memory cost of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">List Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is always </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">n</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">M</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> because the length of table is fixed. The memory cost of Dict Contingency Table will be </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">R</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">d</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, where </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">R</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">d</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">we need to make subtraction between two dictionaries. If the value in the dictionary to be subtracted is zero, it is not necessary to make subtraction any more. Because the number subtracted is always larger than that value in another dictionary. For instance,</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. Because some subtraction between zero and zero are avoid, there will not be a new key and value pair added into the dictionary which is supposed to be zero.</plain_text>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">In </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">this</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> dense ADtree, Vary nodes are used to represents </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">whose</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> attribute</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> value</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> its ADnodes children represent. But when using dense ADtree as a contingency table,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> an</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> ADnode always has only one Vary node child, because contingency table is built for only one set of attributes. So Vary nodes are no</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">t</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> necessary here and could be omitted.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Secondly</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, not counts in all the ADnodes are necessary actually. Because when getti</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ng the result of a query (</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, ..., </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(n)</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">When getting count from </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Tree Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, if there is any CTnode has zero count in the path of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">query</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, it will return 0</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> as shown in the algorithm</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="Heading3" styleName="heading 3">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="16" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">Subtraction of Tree Contingency Tables</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Subtraction of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Tree Contingency Tables</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">in total</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> different that of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">List Contingency Tables</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> and </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Dict Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Because in Tree Contingency Tables the structures being subtracted are not linear structures, but trees.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Subtraction of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Tree Contingency Tables</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> might be two situations.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">First possible situation is that, the tree </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">to subtract and the tree to be subtracted are the same on structure, namely each corresponding CTnode has same number of children. But the counts in the two trees are different.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Consider two contingency tables </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">ct</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">3</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">) and </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">cta2, a3a1=1</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. And attribute </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="11" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="11" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> has only two </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">arities</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> 1 and 2. The MCV of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is 2. So we need to subtract </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">cta2, a3a1=1</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> from </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">ct</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">(</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">3</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">) to get the MCV contingency table </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">cta2, a3a1=2</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The subtraction of this situation is simple. We only need to subtract the counts of the CTnodes in the corresponding positions in the two trees. The counts of the leaves CTnodes in </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">cta2, a3a1=2</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> would be 2, 0, 1 and 1.</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The second possible situation is that, the tree to be subtracted is smaller than the tree to subtract. It is smaller here means that tree has less CTnodes, not having smaller counts. </plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The process of building </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Iterated Tree Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is similar with </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Iterated List Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. However, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">CTnode could be pushed to and popped from the stack. When building Iterated List Contingency Table, counts in the list are updated by indicated by a pointer. But in the tree structure, though it is easy to use a pointer pointing at a CTnode and move the pointer to its child, it is difficult to move up to a CTnode’s parent node. As a result, we push the CTnode whose children nodes are supposed to be built in next several loops.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

      <table_row tag="table_row" index="0">

      <table_row tag="table_row" index="1">
        <table_cell tag="table_cell" fontName="" fontSize="10.5" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none" column="0">

            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">

            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">({</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(1)</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, </plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(2)</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, ..., </plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i(n)</plain_text>

            </text_run>
            <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

          <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">	</plain_text>
              <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Creates a new stack called </plain_text>
            </text_run>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">algorithm for</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> subtraction of Iterated Tree Contingency Table is also similar with that of Tree Contingency Table, since it also uses recursion </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">approach</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> to make subtraction of trees.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The difference is that, in this subtraction algorithm, the depth of trees that participating subtraction must be provided. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">It also has a return value to indicate whether </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">the subtraction result is zero. Because the calculation result of MCV part might be zero, the function MakeContingencyTable has to assign the MCV subtree as number 0 when the subtraction result is 0.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <line_break tag="line_break" />
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="22" fontColor="#1F497D" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="1" styleName="样式1">

      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">This chapter gives an introduction for implementation of sparse ADtree and Full Contingency Tale and other six alternative contingency tables. </plain_text>

      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> stores the counts of a query that the ADnode represents. The query could be </plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">such as</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. But the ADnode does not save the attribute value in itself. For saving memory, the attribute value of one ADnode is represented by the index of an ADnode in the children list of parent Vary node. Namely, in the children list of</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> Vary node, the </plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">th</plain_text>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">i</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. For example, the ADnode saved in the 4</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">th</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> child in the </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">children </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> represents </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">j</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">j</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is the attribute number </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">n attribute </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">MCV</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> which indicates which</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> the most common value in its </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, are used for making the attributes private. This is called private name mangling which will transform the name with another one that starts with one underscore and the class name followed by the attribute name [10]. For instance, </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> combines several contingency tables into a bigger one. In </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">other words, it concatenates all contingency tables </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ctai2, ai(3), …, ai(n)ai(1)=k</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">(1≤k≤ni1)</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">to </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">get </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <formula tag="formula">ct(ai2, aa3, …, ai(n))</formula>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">.</plain_text>

      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> make subtraction between each associated rows in two contingency tables. It is used </plain_text>
      </text_run>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> calculate contingency tables for MCV subtrees. Since it is complicated to make subtraction between trees, subtraction is made between contingency tables afte</plain_text>
      </text_run>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">r they are built from </plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> is what</plain_text>
