    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Because</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> the constructor does not use recursion to build the contingency table, an instance of ContingencyTable does not represent CTnode. The tree structure is represented by nested list which is called </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">class attribute</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">ctTree</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. For example, to represent the tree shown in </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Figure 3-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">12, the </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">ctTree</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> would be a list of: </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[ [</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1, 1], [1, 3], None]. By using nested list, it is more convenient to get a count of a query. We do not need to trace the child of CTnodes for each number in a query. Instead, for a query {</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=2, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">=1}, we can just return the value of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">ctTree</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">[</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1][0] which means the first number in the second list of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">ctTree</plain_text>

      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="22" fontColor="#1F497D" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none" styleId="1" styleName="样式1">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="22" fontColor="#1F497D" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="22" fontColor="#1F497D" bold="true" italic="false" underline="none">Testing and Evaluation</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">This chapter explains </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">the test</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">s</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> and evaluation of the original </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Full Contingency Table</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Because there might be different performance of building </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Dict Contingency Tables</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> when all records are distinct. The </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">test</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">s</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> on number of records has</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> two parts, which tests non-distinct records and distinct records respectively.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> And to make the test simple, all </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">arities</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> are set the same value at the same time. Namely, the arity list changes from {1, 1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, ...,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> 1}, {2, 2, ..., 2} to {n, n, ..., n}.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">To test the time </plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">for</plain_text>

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> building contingency tables on those five factors, one library of Python profiler, cProfile, is used. In test</plain_text>

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> of each factor, a dataset is randomly generated. Then a sparse ADtree is built from the dataset</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">, and used for building a </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">number of contingency tables. Only one of the five factors is changing in one series of test</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">s</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. Other factors maintain fixed values. Because the time </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">for</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> building one contingency table is usually very short and no longer than one second, and test</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">ing</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> on one random dataset could not reflect the particular situation, a large number of random dataset are generated in one particular combination of five factors. </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">he average value is calculated to represent the time </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">for</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The building time of some contingency tables decrease slightly with the increasing of data size as shown in Figure 5-2. This might because the sequence of testing different contingency tables affects the building efficiency. In other words, because </plain_text>

However, the effects are not very big. In these tests, the decreasing of building time is less than 0.1ms. Similar situations also happen in tests on number of records, which show slightly decreasing with the increasing of data size</plain_text>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">: Comparing contingency table on Rmin from 0 to 10000</plain_text>

    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The building time presents a staircase-like increas</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">e</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. The time increases rapidly at the Rmin value of 1250, 2500, 5000 and remains at the same level between two </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">increasing</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. This is because the attributes of datasets are all binary. Therefore each Vary node has two ADnodes children</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. The counts in the two ADnodes trend to be the same with a large number of statistics in the test</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">s</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. There are 10000 records in the dataset. As a result, the building time increases rapidly at each Rmin=10000/2</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">x</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. In </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">other words, the larger Rmin is, the less space ADtree need, but meanwhile the more time it takes to build contingency table from the ADtree with </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">Leaf-List</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. So it is better to choose a value of Rmin close to the edge of rapidly increasing on contingency table building time with a relatively smaller memory cost of ADtree.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The percentage of building time compared with that of Full Contingency Table could represent how much the alternative implementation improved the performance. The </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Figure 5-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">13 demonstrates how much the six contingency tables have improved compared with the original algorithm.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The percentage on five aspects: Length of arity list, value of arities, number of non-distinct records, and number of distinct records and length of attribute list are shown respectively. Each pentagon represents on contingency table. The nearer the five vertices of pentagon is to the centre, the less time it takes to build that contingency table.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">As shown in </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Figure 5-</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">13, generally contingency tables which use iteration are faster than that use recursion. Contingency tables which use list, especially Iterated List Contingency Table, perform well when there are many attributes with large arities. Contingency tables with tree structure perform better with large number of records instead.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Generally the performance in large number of distinct records and non-distinct records only differ for contingency tables using dictionary. Contingency tables using tree structure is not very suitable for building from sparse ADtree with a very long attribute list.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>

    </paragraph>

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">The iteration approach used in the fasted algorithm of </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="true" underline="none">

        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> discussed in this report is actually </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">a top</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">-down iteration. Namely, build</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">s</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> a bigger contingency table </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">by</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> building some smaller contingency tables</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> first</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> and </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">then </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">combining them into a bigger one. However, system has to save the </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">necessary</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> information of building bigger contingency tables in the stack, which is possible to be optimized by using bottom-up iteration. In other words, </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">

      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> the stack and starts from building the </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">smallest</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> contingency tables and gradually concatenates them into bigger tables. Therefore </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">the memory and time cost on pushing and popping stack could be saved.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
    </paragraph>
    <paragraph tag="paragraph" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">Because the algorithms in this report are implemented in Python which is a script language and what we aiming at is to reduce the building time. As a result,</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> by implementing in C or C++, it could be faster than script languages </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">such as</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> Python</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> [1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">1</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">.</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">One of the reasons is that Python is an interpreted language, while C is a compiled language. The interpreter has to </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">interpret</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> the procedures when the programs are running. And the </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">executable</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> files are generated by compiling codes once before they are executed. The codes </plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">executed</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> are actually machine codes which do not need to be compiled or interpreted and can be executed directly by CPU</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none"> [12</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">]</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
        <plain_text tag="plain_text" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">. In summary, a</plain_text>
      </text_run>
      <text_run tag="text_run" fontName="Times New Roman" fontSize="12" fontColor="" bold="false" italic="false" underline="none">
